## C7 — Orchestration note [REWRITTEN — canon now consistent]

> One companion structure serves daily practice. The lenses also gather into three square arrangements — articulation, encounter, transformation — and these remain the working guide for how lenses combine in a live inquiry: which to enter through, which to braid, where the real tension between lived and observed gets held. The harmonic families answer *what is the deep relational geometry*; the orchestration squares answer *how do I run a session*. Map and manual.

(Site naming: harmonic families always by name — Being / Becoming / Knowing-Unknowing; the lens squares always "the orchestration squares". The canon has carried this consistently since the correction pass.)
